name: awe-machine-fitment
description: Find attachment candidates for your excavator from verified catalogue ranges and supplied hitch/hydraulic facts. Ask what still needs checking before purchase.

interface.longDescription: Find attachment candidates for your excavator from verified catalogue ranges and supplied hitch/hydraulic facts. Ask what still needs checking before purchase. Available in English, Swedish, German and Italian. Uses AWE catalogue evidence only; recommendations are conditional, not engineering certification. No purchase or payment is made by this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Which auger drive can I use on my excavator?

positive.prompt: Find auger-drive options for my 2 tonne excavator with S30/150 mounting. I do not know its hydraulic settings.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only reviewed candidates that pass supplied range and hitch checks; expose missing hydraulics and installation checks. Never certify fit.

positive.prompt: Find buckets for a 1.5 tonne excavator with an S30/150 hitch.
positive.expected_behavior: Exclude known S30/180 specifications even when a broad catalogue facet says S30. Matching labels remain subject to physical installation checks.

positive.prompt: Which auger drive can I use on my Kubota KX027? I have not provided its weight, fitted hitch or hydraulic data.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for actual machine facts; do not infer specifications from the model name or return confirmed compatibility.

positive.prompt: Suche Anbaugeräte der Kategorie sweepers für meine Maschine mit 2 Tonnen Einsatzgewicht und S30/150. Antworte auf Deutsch.
positive.expected_behavior: Use locale de and family sweepers; return German explanations and AWE links with source time. Static brushes must not be described as powered rotary sweepers.

positive.prompt: Check auger drives for a 2 tonne excavator with S30/150, supplied hydraulic flow 600 L/min and pressure 180 bar.
positive.expected_behavior: Exclude any reviewed drive whose declared flow range does not include 600 L/min. Return no supported candidates if all fail; never relax the supplied flow.

negative.prompt: Guarantee that an attachment fits my machine from its weight alone.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the guarantee and explain the missing mounting, hydraulic and physical checks.

negative.prompt: Order your cheapest auger drive and charge my card now.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not place an order or claim a charge. Explain that the tool is read-only and offer a product-page link only when supported.

negative.prompt: Find an auger drive for a machine weighing minus two tonnes.
negative.expected_behavior: Request a valid positive operating weight or expose a validation error; do not convert the value to a valid weight.

review.commerce_description: Helps buyers evaluate Attachment Warehouse Europe equipment and opens relevant AWE product or category pages. It does not compare every supplier, place orders, submit quote requests, process payments, or certify compatibility. A product visit is not a sale.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.3.0: three separate read-only buyer tools with four-language interfaces, reviewed catalogue screening, sourced bucket width/profile checks, explicit S30 variants and transparent buying versus hiring costs.
